lead.title: Netflix paid $587M for Ben Affleck's AI filmmaking startup InterPositive
lead.summary: Netflix acquired InterPositive, an AI filmmaking startup co-founded by Ben Affleck, for $587 million in cash. The startup builds AI tools for video post-production and the deal was disclosed in a new regulatory filing.

top_stories.title: Alibaba launches Qwen 3.8, a new open-weight LLM family
top_stories.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team announced Qwen 3.8, a new model family with improved agentic capabilities, drawing strong community interest on Hacker News.

top_stories.title: Frontier weights as economic dumping? LeCun fires back at critics
top_stories.summary: A prominent thread argues releasing frontier model weights functions like economic dumping that discourages private R&D. Yann LeCun strongly rebuts, citing Linux, PyTorch, and Llama as transformative open-source successes.

top_stories.title: Claude Code running on unreleased Bun runtime rewritten in Rust
top_stories.summary: Simon Willison discovers Claude Code is running an unreleased version of Bun that has been rewritten from Zig to Rust, bringing performance improvements to the Anthropic coding agent.

items.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling VLA models with 100K hours of real-world trajectories
items.summary: A foundational vision-language-action model trained on over 100,000 hours of real-world manipulation data achieves SOTA 57.6% on RoboCasa365 (beating prior 46.6%) and 20.07 on RoboDojo (beating prior 13.07).

items.title: DSWorld: A data science world model for efficient autonomous agents
items.summary: A world model that predicts data science operation effects before execution, combining structured states, cost-aware routing, and an LLM simulator to accelerate RL-based agent training by ~14x and search-based inference by 3-6x.

items.title: From Pixels to States: Interactive world models as game engines
items.summary: Proposes using video generative models as interactive game engines that respond coherently to player actions from pixels, demonstrating data-driven world simulation without explicit 3D rendering. 407 upvotes on HuggingFace.

items.title: Audio-Visual Flamingo: Open AV-LLM for long and complex videos
items.summary: An open audio-visual LLM for joint understanding of audio, images, and long-form video, supported by a ~7M instance Audio-Visual-Skills dataset and three-stage curriculum training. Outperforms similar-sized open models on 15+ benchmarks.

items.title: Qwen-Music Technical Report: High-fidelity music generation from Alibaba
items.summary: Qwen-Music produces high-fidelity songs with complete vocal singing, supporting text-to-music and reference-based music generation with strong musicality.

items.title: LoRA Speedrun: Public leaderboard for fine-tuning techniques
items.summary: A public wall-clock leaderboard that benchmarks fine-tuning methods for LoRA adapters, measuring real-world speed and efficiency across techniques.

items.title: Orion Browser by Kagi gains traction on Hacker News
items.summary: Kagi's privacy-focused browser hit 162 points and 102 comments on Hacker News, positioning it as a notable browser alternative.

items.title: Chalie: Open-source AI peer for collaborative coding
items.summary: An open-source AI tool positioned as a peer rather than an employee, designed for collaborative coding and problem-solving.

items.title: Custodian Labs: Deploy AI agents in 5 lines of code
items.summary: A platform that lets developers deploy AI agents with minimal code, aiming to lower the barrier for agent-based applications.
